summary: Bit-buffer writer that serializes three prefix values into a 16-bit accumulator (offset 5803) using a bit position dword at offset 5805: a2-257 as a 5-bit field, a3-1 as a 5-bit field, then a4-4 as a 4-bit field. Each field flushes two accumulator bytes into the output buffer at cursor offset 20 plus base offset 8 when the accumulated bit count crosses its threshold (11, 11, 12). A following loop runs a4 times, taking each symbol from byte_5B7DEC[i] and packing a 3-bit code from the word table at offset 2676 + 4*value with threshold 13. The block closes with two CompressionBitstreamPacker calls, a2-1 then a3-1. ABI leads the Bit_Buffer_Writer cluster and is invoked by HuffmanBitStreamEncoder (0x005381F0).

Pack value a2-257 into the accumulator (word at offset 5803) shifted by the current bit position; when the bit position exceeds 11, flush the two accumulator bytes at cursor offset 20 plus base offset 8 and rebase the accumulator, subtracting 11 from the bit position
Pack value a3-1 into the accumulator with the same 5-bit shape and flush threshold 11, writing the two buffered bytes out at the cursor plus base offset 8
Pack value a4-4 into the accumulator as a 4-bit field with flush threshold 12

Loop a4 times: each iteration reads byte_5B7DEC[i], indexes the word table at offset 2676 + 4*value, packs that word as a 3-bit field with flush threshold 13, and advances the output cursor by two bytes on each flush
Call CompressionBitstreamPacker with a2-1 (a2 restored from the preserved copy) as the argument
Call CompressionBitstreamPacker with a3-1 as the argument; its return value becomes the function result
Return the result of the second CompressionBitstreamPacker call
